name: Disclosure regime

subjectOf.text: Reliance on prospectuses and other disclosures by an unconstrained mutual fund that in all material respects complies with the Company Act may be insufficient to protect retail investors.
subjectOf.abstract: a reliance on prospectuses and other disclosures by a UMF that in all material respects complies with the Company Act may be insufficient to protect retail investors.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: unconstrained mutual funds in full compliance with the Company Act
retail investors relying on prospectus disclosure

subjectOf.text: The SEC should re-evaluate its reliance on the Company Act's disclosure regime in its current form as the best means of protecting retail investors from the risks of investing in unconstrained mutual funds.
subjectOf.abstract: Regardless of the SEC's reason for inaction, the authors believe that the SEC should re-evaluate its reliance on the Company Act's disclosure regime in its current form as the best means of protecting retail investors in relation to the risks posed by investing in UMFs.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: SEC policy toward unconstrained mutual funds

subjectOf.text: The SEC continues to rely on disclosure as the means of mitigating investor risk from unconstrained and other mutual funds irrespective of the complexity of those funds' portfolios and strategies.
subjectOf.abstract: seems to reflect the SEC's continued reliance on disclosure as a means of mitigating the risks to investors from investing in UMFs and other mutual funds irrespective of the complexity of their portfolios and strategies,
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729
scope_conditions: SEC disclosure policy for mutual funds as of 2016
